title: The Dew Valley Infestation
description: The Dew Valley Infestation — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 25 Whisker Ratlings in Dew Valley Forest. Afterward, return to Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative in Dew Valley.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Red Rocks

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 25 Whisker Ratlings in Dew Valley Forest. Afterward, return to Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative in Dew Valley.

Offer:

Welcome to Dew Valley, Dungeon Runner!

I am assigned to assign you assignments, and be advised that I treat my responsibilities *very* seriously. If you correctly handle my missions, it will reflect well in *both* of our permanent records...and someday help me get back to my rightful place behind the scenes on the front lines.

The Whiskers are first...they overmined during the Great Fizz Rock Rush, and have been plaguing Dew Valley ever since. Their numbers have been increasing, and the forest now swarms with them like never before.

Rid the Dew Valley Forest of some of the smaller Whisker Ratlings. Return here when you're done and I will give you something more challenging. Tip: If you have already killed most of the creatures in Dew Valley Forest, consider going deeper into the dungeon. Alternately, you might want to right-click on your character health bar and or choose to Reset Instances to force the dungeon to re-stock all its monsters.

Turn-in:

Well done. Your payment is very well deserved...or at least awarded promptly.

Objectives:

  • Slay Whisker Ratlings

Level range: 1–15
